mapper.sql: id, business_domain_id, ticket_type_id, record_type, version_no, form_schema, plugin_revision, published_by, published_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket_form_schema WHERE ticket_type_id = #{ticketTypeId} AND business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND record_type = 'draft' AND version_no = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ticket_form_schema WHERE ticket_type_id = #{ticketTypeId} AND business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND record_type = 'published' ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_form_schema ( business_domain_id, ticket_type_id, record_type, version_no, form_schema, plugin_revision, published_by, published_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{businessDomainId}, #{ticketTypeId}, #{recordType}, #{versionNo}, #{formSchema}, #{pluginRevision}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_form_schema SET form_schema = #{formSchema}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE ticket_type_id = #{ticketTypeId} AND business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND record_type = 'draft' AND version_no = 0
